note: Drops summary, hypotheses, recommendations and tool_calls_used from the signal extra payload and removes the verdict weight map, using a flat weight.
Moves ErrorResponseSerializer into posthog/api/utils.py, imports it from there in feature_flag.py and deletes it from the tasks serializers.
Adds module constant FULL_PROPERTIES_KEY and uses it at both the select-field producer and the row consumer checks.
Deletes the hand-written cohortsUsedIn builder and getUsedIn API helper; cohort edit logic switches to the generated client.
Renames the tool's name string to create_ai_trace_parser and adds a YAML length cap; the max_tools module and MaxTool naming stay.
Adds a loadSignalsFailure listener and a connected setupStatus value to the onboarding logic, extending rather than removing the extra kea wiring.
Renames monitoringKafkaProducer to hogTransformerProducer with config prefix HOGTRANSFORMER_PRODUCER instead of WARPSTREAM_PRODUCER.
Event trait headers() now returns CapturedEventHeaders built with the Context; removes the custom key-value header builder and its tests.
Filters read-only scopes on an unprivilegedExcluded scope flag instead of comparing the llm_gateway key; scopes.tsx updated accordingly.
Replaces custom Turnstile script loading and window globals with the @marsidev/react-turnstile package component.
Generalizes the endpoint to personal_spend with an optional ai_product filter and by-product breakdown; no MCP tool exposure in this commit.
Replaces the hardcoded open-invoices code string with BillingAPIErrorCodes.OPEN_INVOICES_ERROR.value; webhook 409 path was already dropped.
Moves TeamAllowlist and its parser/tests into common_types::cohort and imports it from both the shuffler and stream processor configs.
Moves filterGroup normalization and query strategies into the MCP ApiClient query endpoint, not the backend API.
Generalizes the spend endpoint to personal_spend with an optional product filter; no MCP tool added in this commit.
Replaces the person and distinct-id batch workers with one generic run_batch_worker taking prepare and execute closures; dedupe functions stay separate.
Extracts the registering-cohorts reconstruction into a collect_registering_cohorts(filters, transferred_inventory) helper.
Splits the publish loop into separate steps for quill-tokens and quill, each capturing its version output.
Removes the top-level dataWarehouseTable global; the synthetic event carries the table as properties.$source_table and consumers match on it.
Passes a checked flag so teams from the limited-billable query skip the second over-limit check.
